column4: Platform Configuration
column5: Configure the cloud field-service platform: work orders, dispatch, mobile app, SLAs and depot set-up for all 4 migration waves. Scope for each wave freezes 2 sprints before its cutover (Wave 4 freeze: Nov 20, 2026).

column4: Data Migration & Reconciliation
column5: Extract, map and load open tickets, 3 years of service history and customer/asset master data from the legacy ticketing system. Gate per wave: reconciliation >= 99.5% and 0 open tickets lost.

column4: Integrations
column5: Integrate the platform with the legacy ERP (billing, parts) and the identity provider (SSO). The legacy ERP interfaces must stay stable until Program Wave 2 (SAP S/4HANA Cloud).

column4: Testing & Quality (SIT/UAT)
column5: SIT and UAT for each migration wave, plus defect management. Gate per wave: UAT pass rate >= 95% and 0 open S1 defects.

column4: Training & Cutover
column5: End-user training, cutover runbooks, rehearsals, go/no-go decisions, hypercare and legacy decommissioning. Target: < 4 hours downtime per depot; legacy system decommissioned by Jan 31, 2027.

column4: Configure work order types, statuses and status transitions
column5:
As a dispatcher, I want work order types and statuses that match our service process, so that every service order follows one lifecycle across all depots.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* the status model agreed with depot managers
*When* a work order moves through Open, In Progress, On Hold and Closed
*Then* only the allowed transitions are possible and each change is logged

*AC2*
*Given* a technician closes a work order
*When* required fields (asset, labor hours, resolution code) are empty
*Then* the platform blocks closure and lists the missing fields

column4: Configure dispatch and scheduling rules per depot
column5:
As a dispatcher, I want auto-dispatch based on skills, territory and on-call rotas, so that P1 tickets reach the right technician quickly.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a P1 ticket is created for a depot
*When* auto-dispatch runs
*Then* the nearest available technician with the required skill, including on-call staff, is assigned

*AC2*
*Given* a depot in a different time zone
*When* a technician opens their calendar
*Then* appointments show in the depot's local time

column4: Configure mobile app offline mode, photo and signature capture
column5:
As a field technician, I want to work offline on site and capture photos and customer signatures, so that I can close jobs where there is no signal.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a technician is offline
*When* they complete a work order with photos and a signature
*Then* all data syncs without loss once the device reconnects

*AC2*
*Given* a supported tablet model
*When* the customer signs
*Then* the signature is stored on the work order and on the service report

column4: Configure SLA policies and P1 escalations
column5:
As a service desk manager, I want SLA clocks and escalations per priority, so that we can track and protect contractual response times.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a ticket is On Hold awaiting parts
*When* time passes
*Then* the SLA clock is paused

*AC2*
*Given* a P1 ticket
*When* it reaches 80% of its response SLA
*Then* an escalation email goes to the depot manager and the service desk

column4: Configure Wave 4 West depots (DEP-31 to DEP-40): territories and technician rosters
column5:
Set up the 10 West depots (Pacific and Mountain time zones) before the Wave 4 scope freeze on Nov 20, 2026.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* the Wave 4 depot list in data/depots.csv
*When* the configuration is deployed to the test environment
*Then* all 10 depots, territories and technician rosters exist and match the depot data

*AC2*
*Given* Pacific and Mountain time zones
*When* SIT schedules a job in each depot
*Then* times are correct in each depot's local time zone

column4: Fix DEF-104: technician calendar ignores depot time zone
column5:
S1 defect DEF-104 found in Wave 4 SIT: technician calendars show Eastern time for every depot. Must be fixed before the Wave 4 go/no-go.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC2*

*When* the related SIT cases are re-run
*Then* they pass and DEF-104 is closed

column4: Build legacy extract and status/priority mapping rules
column5:
Extract tickets, customers and assets from the unsupported legacy database without vendor support, and map legacy codes to the new platform.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* read-only access to the legacy database
*When* the extract job runs
*Then* open tickets and 3 years of history are extracted for the selected depots

*AC2*
*Given* each legacy status and priority code
*When* the mapping is applied
*Then* every code maps to exactly one platform value and unmapped codes are reported

column4: Wave 2 migration load, reconciliation and duplicate clean-up (Northeast)

column4: Fix DEF-100: open tickets dropped when legacy depot code has a trailing space
column5:
S1 defect DEF-100 (Data Migration). The Wave 3 dress-rehearsal load dropped 4 open tickets (LT-011529, LT-011684, LT-011854, LT-011902) because their legacy depot code has a trailing space. This breaks the gate "0 open tickets lost".

Linked to the Wave 3 NO-GO (assessment 2026-11-13: readiness score 68.5, 4 gate criteria failed; see sql/05_readiness_score.sql).

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* legacy depot codes with leading or trailing spaces
*When* the extract runs
*Then* codes are trimmed and every ticket maps to a valid depot_id

*AC2*
*Given* the corrected load for Wave 3
*When* sql/01_reconciliation.sql Q2 and Q3 are run
*Then* 0 open tickets are missing, including the 4 tickets above

*AC3*
*Given* the fix is deployed
*When* the Data Migration UAT cases are re-run
*Then* they pass and DEF-100 is closed

column4: Wave 3 reconciliation remediation to >= 99.5% (Midwest)
column5:
The Wave 3 dress-rehearsal reconciliation is 98.7% (threshold 99.5%). 47 discrepancies: 21 missing records, 16 status mismatches (mainly Closed loaded as Open), 10 dropped dates. There are also 7 duplicate loads.

Linked to the Wave 3 NO-GO (assessment 2026-11-13: readiness score 68.5, 4 gate criteria failed; see sql/05_readiness_score.sql).

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* the status mapping rules
*When* a legacy Closed or Cancelled ticket is loaded
*Then* it keeps the same status in the platform

*AC2*
*Given* closed legacy tickets
*When* they are loaded
*Then* created_date and closed_date are never NULL

*AC3*
*Given* the Wave 3 re-load
*When* sql/01_reconciliation.sql Q4 and sql/02_data_quality.sql are run
*Then* reconciliation is >= 99.5% and there are 0 duplicate loads

column4: Wave 4 legacy extract and mock load (West)
column5:
Run the extract and a mock load for the 3,214 legacy tickets in depots DEP-31 to DEP-40, including the DEF-100 trimming fix.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

column4: Integrate work order close with legacy ERP billing
column5:
Send closed work orders (labor, parts, travel) to the legacy ERP to create invoices.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a billable work order
*When* it is closed in the platform
*Then* an invoice request reaches the legacy ERP within 15 minutes

*AC2*
*Given* labor hours with decimals
*When* the invoice is created
*Then* hours and amounts match the work order exactly

column4: Integrate parts reservations and stock levels with legacy ERP
column5:
Reserve parts from depot stock and keep stock levels in sync with the ERP.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a technician requests a part
*When* the request is saved
*Then* the part is reserved in the ERP

*AC2*
*Given* a work order is cancelled
*When* it has reserved parts
*Then* the reservation is released

column4: Set up SSO with the identity provider and role-based access
column5:
SSO and role model approved by Security before Wave 1 (charter constraint).

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a Meraki user with an active corporate account
*When* they sign in
*Then* they are authenticated through SSO with no separate password

*AC2*
*Given* the depot supervisor role
*When* a supervisor opens a closed ticket
*Then* they can read it but cannot edit it

column4: Fix DEF-112: invoices not created for work orders closed after migration
column5:
S1 defect DEF-112 (ERP Billing Integration). Work orders migrated as open and then closed in the platform do not create an invoice in the legacy ERP. This is a revenue and financial-close risk (R-12).

Linked to the Wave 3 NO-GO (assessment 2026-11-13: readiness score 68.5, 4 gate criteria failed; see sql/05_readiness_score.sql).

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* a ticket migrated as Open
*When* it is closed in the platform
*Then* an invoice is created in the legacy ERP

*AC2*
*Given* Wave 1-2 work orders closed since go-live
*When* a billing reconciliation is run
*Then* every billable work order has an invoice, and gaps are back-billed

*AC3*
*Given* the fix is deployed
*When* the ERP Billing UAT cases are re-run
*Then* they pass and DEF-112 is closed

column4: Wave 3 go/no-go decision and revised cutover plan
column5:
The readiness assessment of Nov 13, 2026 gives a NO-GO for the Nov 20 cutover: score 68.5/100, gates failed for UAT pass rate (91.1%), open S1 defects (2), reconciliation (98.7%) and open tickets lost (4). The blocking items are linked to this issue.

h3. Acceptance Criteria

*AC1*
*Given* the readiness scorecard (sql/05_readiness_score.sql)
*When* the steering committee meets on Nov 18
*Then* the GO or NO-GO decision is recorded with the sponsor's approval

*AC2*
*Given* a NO-GO decision
*When* the plan is revised
*Then* a new Wave 3 cutover date is proposed that respects the weekend-only and Thanksgiving-week constraints and the impact on Wave 4 (Dec 18) is assessed

*AC3*
*Given* a revised plan
*When* it is shared
*Then* depot managers, the service desk and the vendor confirm the new date

column4: Decommission the legacy ticketing system

*Then* a read-only archive is available and the decommission is signed off by IT and Security by Jan 31, 2027
